urlText: Museum Station closed for Mardi Gras Parade
content:
From 5pm Saturday 1 March until 4am Sunday 2 March, Museum Station will be closed and trains will not stop at the station during this time for the safety of large crowds gathering for the Sydney Gay and Lesbian Mardi Gras Parade.
 
Use Central, St James, Martin Place or Town Hall stations instead.
 
Note: Pedestrian crossing of the parade route on Oxford St and Flinders St will be available until 7pm before the event gets underway. After 7pm you won’t be able to cross the road. Make sure you head towards your preferred viewing side of the parade early to secure a spot.
  • Northern side parade viewing (Darlinghurst): Use Town Hall, St James, Martin Place or Kings Cross station
  • Southern side parade viewing (Surry Hills): Use Central station for access to the southern side.
  • For Moore Park viewing, catch light rail services from Central Chalmers Street.
For more details on transport options and service changes, visit the Sydney Gay & Lesbian Mardi Gras Parade event page.

urlText: Changes to school bus services and pass requirements in North Rothbury and Maitland area
content:
From Friday 31 January, a new morning and afternoon school bus service will run between North Rothbury and Rutherford Technology High School to meet student demand following community feedback. 
  • School route S526: A new service in the morning, operated by Grace Coaches will service North Rothbury, Branxton, Greta and Lochinvar before arriving at Rutherford Technology High School.
  • School route S526: A new afternoon service, operated by Grace Coaches will depart Rutherford Technology High School and service Greta, Branxton and North Rothbury.
Changes to other services:
  • Maitland Grossman High School and Maitland High School students who previously took the Grace Coaches S520 morning service should now take CDC school route 2571 and transfer to the regular route 180 service at Rutherford Shopping Centre (Hillview Street). In the afternoon, students can utilise the 2194 CDC school service.
  • Students from Maitland Public School, St John the Baptist Primary School and All Saints College who took the Grace Coaches S520 service to and from school will now catch the CDC school route 2712 morning service and the 2194 afternoon service.  
  • The S520 school route has been redesigned to service Rutherford and Aberglasslyn. 
Important:
  • Departure and arrival times and routes of some services have changed. Please check Trip Planner for details.
  • The school bus you travel on may be a CDC bus (operated by Hunter Valley Buses) or a Grace Coaches bus. If it is a CDC bus, you will need an Opal card. If it is a Grace Coaches bus, you will need a school travel pass. If your service has changed, find out more about how to apply for a pass. 
To view the adjusted routes and plan your trip, visit Trip Planner.

urlText: Port Macquarie bus service changes
content:
From Tuesday 3 December 2024, a temporary shuttle bus service will connect passengers to Route 322 bus services as planned roadworks commence near Lighthouse Plaza Shopping Centre.
 
Emerald Drive at Ocean Drive will re-open, and Matthew Flinders Drive at Ocean Drive will close from 3 December until the end of February.
 
The changes will impact several bus routes and school services in the area.
 
Routes affected:

  • 333 - Kendall to Port Macquarie via Bonny Hills
  • 334 - Lighthouse Plaza to Port Macquarie
Route 322 will run from the bus stop at Pacific Drive after Waterview Close (Stop ID: 2444262) connecting with a free shuttle service to allow passengers to travel to/from Lighthouse Plaza.
 
Shuttle service will run to and from temporary stop at Matthew Flinders Drive and eastern end of Kelvin Grove via Matthew Flinders Drive, Bangalay Road, Pacific Drive and Ocean Drive to Lighthouse Plaza.
 
Missed stop: Ocean Dr at Matthew Flinders Dr (Stop ID: 2444201)
Nearest alternative stop: Lighthouse Plaza, Emerald Dr (Stop ID: 244468)

Service changes
  • Route 322 will start and finish at temporary stop in Matthew Flinders Drive at Kelvin Grove.
  • Route 323 will be temporarily discontinued and replaced by routes 322 and 324.
  • Route 333 to Laurieton will divert from Ocean Drive to Emerald Drive, Lighthouse Plaza due to temporary closure of bus stop (Ocean Drive at Matthew Flinders Drive).
  • Route 334 to set down at Lighthouse Plaza, Emerald Drive due to temporary closure of bus stop (Ocean Drive at Matthew Flinders Drive).
School services affected
  • School routes S443, S444, S445, S458, S462, S522, S554, S559, S562, S566, S567, S586, S590, S595 and S597 will also be adjusted.
